opening.speaker: Ogma
opening.text: Prince Marth, I am Ogma, a mercenary of Talys. I have been ordered by my king to join your army, along with my three subordinates.

opening.speaker: Ogma
opening.text: This is the port of Galder, which is currently controlled by pirates. The Grustian army has also come to defeat your highness. Please be cautious.

recruit_castor.speaker: Caeda
recruit_castor.text: Castor!? You're Castor! Why are you doing this...?

recruit_castor.speaker: Castor
recruit_castor.text: Ah... Lady Caeda, I'm sorry. My mother is ill. I desperately need gold to buy medicine...

recruit_castor.speaker: Caeda
recruit_castor.text: So you were hired by the pirates? I see. Well, I have some gold with me. Take it to buy medicine for your mother.

recruit_castor.speaker: Castor
recruit_castor.text: ...! You would be so kind to me, even though I betrayed my country... Lady Caeda, please forgive me! I... Lady Caeda, I will dedicate my life to you!

village_galder.speaker: Galder Villager
village_galder.text: Citizens of Altea, please rescue Sister Lena. Sister Lena went to that terrifying Devil Mountain to cure the illnesses of the poor people, despite our pleas for her to stay, and she hasn't returned. Sister Lena is like an angel to us. Please, you must rescue her. As payment for this, here is 3000 Gold. Please, we beg you, help Sister Lena.

house_stats_tip.speaker: Villager
house_stats_tip.text: As your Skill increases, it becomes more likely for you to land a critical hit. As your Speed increases, it becomes more likely for you to dodge enemy attacks.

house_ranged_tip.speaker: Villager
house_ranged_tip.text: Archers and Hunters can only attack from a distance. Since they can't engage in close-quarters combat, they should avoid it.

boss_gomer.startCombat: Don't underestimate the Galder pirates. I'll show you how sharp my hand axe is!

ending.speaker: Galder Elder
ending.text: Your highness, thank you very much for driving out the pirates. Now we can live in peace. To reach Aurelis from here, you must cross Devil Mountain.

ending.speaker: Galder Elder
ending.text: Please be careful. There is a group of bandits called the Soothsires on Devil Mountain. They are greatly feared for raiding nearby villages and attacking travelers. I hear that one of their bodyguards, Navarre, is particularly skilled. Please do not let your guard down. I am praying for your safety.
